```{r Read in data}

homicides_stl <- read_csv("homicide-data.csv") %>% 
  mutate(city_name = paste(city, state, sep = ", ")) %>% 
  filter(city == "St. Louis")
```


```{r}
homicides_stl <- homicides_stl %>%  
  mutate(
    disposition = case_when(disposition %in% c("Closed without arrest", "Open/No arrest") ~ "unsolved", 
                            disposition %in% c("Closed by arrest") ~ "solved"))
```
